author: managed_restore_ops_review; optional infrastructure implementation assigned by root
change: Optional ARN-parameterized full JSON secret injection into the app task; conditional exact-secret GetSecretValue on its execution role only.
asserted_boundaries: Empty default removes optional policy from active resources and removes the app Secrets property; service count remains zero.

Strict full ARN permits only us-east-1/account877573132739/genui-qualification- names with bounded lowercase name and normal six-character generated suffix. Other account/region/prefix/wildcards/selectors/whitespace/lengths fail.
Enabled policy contains only secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on the exact supplied ARN and only the app execution role. No task-role or migration-role privileges change.
Enabled app secret is only GENUI_AUTH_QUALIFICATION_CONFIG_JSON with full ARN ValueFrom; no FILE env or raw secret in template, output or plain environment.
Migration retains only PGPASSWORD from its existing separate execution channel; no additional secret is created.
No unconditional dependency on the conditional policy can suppress default task/service resources.
Existing network, schedule, stopped-service, image, storage, task size and role tests continue to pass.
runtime_contract: The separately owned runtime consumes 1..8192 UTF-8 bytes in GENUI_AUTH_QUALIFICATION_CONFIG_JSON only for serve, privately materializes the file, removes raw env and passes only its file path to the Rust child. Schema/expiry/operator auth remains the Rust validator responsibility.
operational_requirements: Observe all service tasks stopped before changing image/config; complete the entire stack update including the conditional policy before activating through preflight.
Root owns binding the selected optional ARN in preflight; this change does not edit the preflight script.
Supply a separately reviewed runtime image with the JSON-to-private-file handoff before enabling injection; old foundation image does not establish this capability.
No custom-key decrypt grant is added. Use the reviewed same-account Secrets Manager default-key provisioning path, or separately review any required key authority.

warnings.message: CDK name heuristic treats QualificationConfigSecretArn as a password parameter. The value is a nonsecret identifier only; NoEcho remains unset so the exact ARN can be checked by live preflight. No secret value is a stack parameter.

limits: Source/template tests are local and do not prove live ECS secret delivery, private-file lifecycle, hosted identity or application admission.
No AWS calls, secret reads/creation, staging or commits by this author.
Changes are left for root independent source/synthesis review and final CI.
